name: Rousette
description: Full RESTCONF server for sysrepo with XML/JSON encoding, YANG module library access, data retrieval/edits, RPC execution, NACM access control, and NETCONF notification streams.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Base container notconf:latest includes netopeer2 + rousette + sysrepo. RESTCONF on port 10080 behind nghttpx reverse proxy on port 80.

eval_notes: Development via Gerrit, GitHub PRs not accepted. Requires C++20 compiler. Complements netopeer2 with RESTCONF access to the same sysrepo datastore. Changes via NETCONF are immediately visible via RESTCONF and vice versa. Newer project from CESNET, actively maintained.
